data.credibility: Management issues long-term growth guidance and broad targets, but frequently drops updates on specific international revenue and volume metrics across subsequent quarters. While they maintain broad optimism, tracking actual follow-through is obscured by gaps in reporting.

lines.line: Promised early teens international growth; actual reached 26.5% but topic was dropped.
Targeted $100 million international foods revenue in 2-3 years; dropped from updates.
Expected 80% South Africa volume growth; dropped without final tracking.
Guided double-digit growth for 5-10 years; 26.5% actual currently keeps it on track.
Projected India capex under Rs. 500-600 crore; status marked slipping.
Aimed to expand outlets by nearly half a million; reiterated and on track.
Guided international capex of $90-100 million for CY27; currently pending delivery.

bull: Consolidated revenue stands at ₹25,931 cr with a net profit of ₹3,479 cr, backed by a solid 22.8% EBITDA margin.
Management guides for continued double-digit growth for the next 5-10 years, supported by an actual 26.5% period growth rate.
The balance sheet remains lightly geared with borrowings of ₹2,508 cr against a net worth of ₹19,578 cr (debt-to-equity of 0.13).
bear: Management has dropped specific tracking on key targets like the $100 million international foods revenue and South Africa volume growth.
India capex guidance of Rs. 500 to 600 crore is already marked as slipping.
Return on Equity stands at 16.4% and ROCE at 19.7% alongside a relatively high P/E ratio of 42.3.
